query.text: 请帮我照看孩子，有情况告诉我。

annotation.text_zh: 锅盖很烫，不要直接用手拿，小心烫伤。
annotation.text_en: The lid is very hot, don't touch it with your bare hands.

annotation.text_zh: 手烫到了吗？快去用冷水冲洗一下。
annotation.text_en: Did you burn your hand? Run it under cold water quickly.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
